title: Use policy and label identity controls
frozenQuestion: Does composition-corrected aggregation follow executable policy identity rather than immutable action-irrelevant analysis labels, and how much apparent aggregation can be created by label composition, value-correlated assignment, or post hoc label selection without changing a transition?

scope.excludedReason: S07 joint matching was infeasible and no S07 intervention is a matched S08 causal control.

identityLayers.cellIdentity: Immutable cell_id used to carry value, executable policy, direction, internal Selection cursor, and analysis metadata through movement.
identityLayers.executablePolicy: Bubble, Insertion, or Selection; the only identity-like field that selects a policy implementation.
identityLayers.analysisLabel: Immutable metadata attached to a cell identity or reconstructed from a frozen assignment; never available to policy observation, proposal, validation, scheduling, stopping, or actuation.
identityLayers.groupingFunction: The prespecified mapping from immutable cell identity to the label whose spatial adjacency is measured. Changing it is an analysis change, not a transition intervention.

allowedPolicyObservations: neighbor or target position where native policy permits
neighbor or target value where native policy permits
fault state where native policy permits
actor Selection cursor for Selection only
labelBlindBoundary.runtimeKeyRule: A labelled validation copy must retain the unlabeled scenario_id and runtime seed so adding metadata cannot indirectly change counter-addressed scheduler draws. The labelled scenario is structurally validated before the runtime key is restored, then executed with scenario-ID recomputation disabled.
labelBlindBoundary.sourceAudit: Reference policy, scheduler, terminal, and transition modules must not access Cell.analysis_label. Existing action-interface permission tests and new AST tests enforce this boundary.

controlFamilies.question: Can two exact-count labels cluster when all 100 cells execute the identical policy?
controlFamilies.population: Bubble-only, Insertion-only, and Selection-only trajectories for both unique_1_100 and repeated_1_10_x10 inputs; 25 frozen holdout base draws per condition.
controlFamilies.analysisAssignment: ghost_random_exact channel 0: a counter-addressed uniform permutation of 50 label-A and 50 label-B assignments, independent of values, positions, and outcomes.

controlFamilies.question: What remains of label aggregation when every identity in a native mixed-policy trajectory has the same analysis label?
controlFamilies.population: All 186 S07 native-control conditions and 25 frozen holdout scenarios per condition.
controlFamilies.analysisAssignment: collapsed: every identity receives label merged:all.

controlFamilies.question: Do exact-count labels assigned independently of executable policy and value acquire reproducible aggregation on native mixed-policy trajectories?
controlFamilies.population: All 186 S07 native-control conditions and 25 frozen holdout scenarios per condition.
controlFamilies.analysisAssignment: ghost_random_exact channel 0, with 50 label-A and 50 label-B identities per scenario.

assignmentLibrary.ghostRandomExact: For each source runtime scenario, use a SHA-256-addressed PCG64DXSM generator to permute 512 broadcast copies of 50 ghost:A and 50 ghost:B labels along the identity axis. Channel row order 0 through 511 is frozen and deterministic; counts are exactly 50/50.
assignmentLibrary.collapsed: Assign merged:all to all 100 identities; exact count is 100.
assignmentLibrary.executablePolicy: Use the immutable executable Policy enum as the grouping label; this is the S07 native-policy reference, not a new run.
assignmentLibrary.valueBlockedDiagnostic: For homogeneous-policy trajectories only, order identities by value then a frozen counter-addressed tie rank; assign the first 50 value:block:A and the rest value:block:B. This is a deliberately confounded post hoc grouping diagnostic and never a primary control.
assignmentLibrary.bestOfChannelsDiagnostic: Within the prespecified candidate set channels 0 through 19, report the largest condition endpoint and its inflation over channel 0. No selected channel is promoted to a confirmatory label.

metrics.exactCompositionExpectation: sum_k n_k(n_k-1)/n^2; 0.49 for 50/50 labels and 0.99 for a single label of count 100
metrics.correctedAdjacency: publication adjacency minus the exact-composition expectation
metrics.peak: maximum of the complete 101-point condition-mean corrected label trajectory
metrics.positiveArea: piecewise-linear integral of the positive part of the complete condition-mean corrected label trajectory
metrics.nullAdjustedEffect: channel-0 endpoint minus the mean endpoint over reference channels 1 through 500
metrics.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across conditions separately within control family and outcome.
metrics.policyReference: S07 native-control policy curves and global dynamic-null adjusted effects are reused byte-for-byte; no kinetic intervention is used.

postHocArtifactRules.compositionArtifact: Report raw collapsed-label adjacency and the exact corrected value; also show the erroneous excess that a universal 0.5 baseline would create.
postHocArtifactRules.valueCorrelationArtifact: Report value-blocked label trajectories on identical-policy runs, including final corrected adjacency, to show grouping induced by label-value construction alone.
postHocArtifactRules.selectionArtifact: Report best-of-20 minus primary-channel endpoint across every condition and outcome.
postHocArtifactRules.exclusionRule: Only channel 0 and assignments named primary above enter the success rule. Value-blocked and best-of-20 results are diagnostics and cannot support the hypothesis.

calibration.pseudoObservations: Channels 501 through 511 are each ranked against channels 1 through 500, pooled across conditions separately for mixed and homogeneous populations.
calibration.tolerance: absolute deviation from alpha no greater than max(0.015, 3.5 times the binomial standard error)
calibration.ties: Report randomized tie ranks and conservative upper-tail rates.

successCriteria.validity: All 450 labelled replay comparisons are exact; policy source audit passes; every assignment has its frozen exact counts; all null-calibration checks pass; run and artifact accounting is complete; S01-S07 are byte-immutable; S09 artifacts are absent.
successCriteria.identicalPolicy: For each primary outcome, at most one of six channel-0 identical-policy controls has BH q <= 0.05; median absolute null-adjusted effect is <= 0.01 for peak and <= 0.005 for positive area.
successCriteria.ghostLabels: For each primary outcome, at most one of 186 channel-0 mixed-policy ghost controls has BH q <= 0.05; median absolute null-adjusted effect is <= 0.005 for peak and <= 0.0025 for positive area.
successCriteria.collapsedLabels: Every same-label mixed-policy corrected trajectory is exactly zero, while its executable-policy curve and endpoint match the S07 native-control source exactly.
successCriteria.policyDiscrimination: In all six balanced absent-association anchors, the S07 global-null adjusted executable-policy peak exceeds the ghost-label adjusted peak by >0.05 and positive area exceeds the ghost-label adjusted positive area by >0.02.
successCriteria.supportive: Validity and all four scientific gates pass.
successCriteria.null: Validity passes but one or more scientific gates fail without a directional contradiction and precision is insufficient.
successCriteria.constrainingOrContradictory: A label changes a required transition, composition/assignment leakage is detected, arbitrary ghost labels show systematic primary aggregation, collapsed labels alter executable-policy trajectories, or policy discrimination reverses.

claimBoundaries: S08 tests immutable analysis labels in the E01 clean-room simulator; it does not prove that every possible implementation is label-blind.
A label grouping can appear spatially structured if it is correlated with value or chosen after looking at outcomes, even when it has no action pathway.
A single collapsed label makes raw adjacency nearly one by composition and therefore demonstrates why exact composition correction is mandatory.

Support would show that the validated aggregation statistic tracks executable policy identity better than arbitrary metadata; it would not establish affinity, attraction, biological adhesion, or an operational attractor.
S08 does not switch policy or label during a trajectory and does not start S09.
